# @theokit/ui — Theo UI (Violet Forge)

> React component library for AI-agent surfaces and cloud (PaaS) dashboards. 103 components (63 primitives + 40 composites) — *primitive* and *composite* are structural terms here, not "generic vs specific": every one of the 103 is an agent/PaaS surface, and the generic chrome (Button, Badge, Select, Table, Sidebar, …) lives in `@usetheo/ui` — see **Which package has what** below. Framework-agnostic (React peer-dep only), ESM-only, Apache-2.0. Built on Radix UI + CVA + lucide-react + Tailwind v4. Same Radix foundation as shadcn — the wedge is the agent/PaaS-specific components built on top.

This file follows the [llms.txt convention](https://llmstxt.org/) and gives an LLM the **factual ground truth** of the project: package name, import paths, component inventory, locked conventions, anti-patterns, and links to the canonical documentation. Treat the bullets below as non-negotiable contracts unless the source files contradict them — in which case the source files win and this file is stale.

## Project metadata

- **npm package:** `@theokit/ui`
- **Current version:** `1.12.1` (npm dist-tag `latest`)
- **License:** Apache-2.0
- **Repository:** `https://github.com/usetheokit/theokit-ui`
- **Companion package (generic primitives):** `@usetheo/ui` — `https://github.com/usetheodev/usetheo-ui`
- **Docs site:** `https://docs.usetheo.dev/theoui`
- **Registry (shadcn CLI):** `https://usetheokit.github.io/theokit-ui/r/{slug}.json`
- **Design-system codename:** Violet Forge
- **Module format:** ESM only (no CJS). `"type": "module"`. Side-effects on `**/*.css`.
- **React peer range:** `>=18.2.0 <20` (works with 18.x and 19.x)
- **Distribution:** npm package install OR copy-paste source via shadcn CLI (registry). Both paths are first-class.

## Which package has what

Two packages, one design system, one token set. Reaching for the wrong one is the most common
mistake a consumer makes, and it costs a rewrite of chrome that already exists.

| You need | Package | Examples |
|---|---|---|
| App chrome: shell, navigation, tables, forms, feedback | **`@usetheo/ui`** | `Sidebar`, `PageShell`, `DataTable`, `Table`, `Select`, `Switch`, `Checkbox`, `FormField`, `Button`, `Badge`, `Dialog`, `Sheet`, `Tabs`, `Tooltip`, `Toast`, `EmptyState`, `Alert`, `Skeleton`, `Pagination`, `CommandPalette` |
| Agent surfaces: the conversation and what surrounds it | **`@theokit/ui`** | `ChatThread`, `ChatMessage`, `ChatComposer`, `ToolCall`, `ToolsList`, `ApprovalCard`, `ModelCard`, `SkillsList`, `AgentTimeline`, `RunStatusPill`, `CapabilityIndicator`, `ContextWindowBar` |
| Cloud/PaaS dashboards | **`@usetheo/ui`** | `ProjectCard`, `DeploymentRow`, `EnvVarEditor`, `MetricsPanel`, `RollbackUI`, `TrendChart` |

`@theokit/ui` is built on `@usetheo/ui` and shares its tokens, so the two compose without a
visual seam — a `<Sidebar>` beside a `<ChatThread>` reads as one product. Install both when the
app has chrome; install only `@theokit/ui` when you are embedding an agent surface into a UI that
already has its own.

**Rule of thumb:** if the component would exist in an app with no agent in it, look in
`@usetheo/ui` first.

## Install

```bash
# Agent surfaces
pnpm add @theokit/ui@next

# …plus the generic chrome, if the app has any (shell, tables, forms, dialogs)
pnpm add @usetheo/ui

# Per-component copy (shadcn-style)
npx shadcn@latest add https://usetheokit.github.io/theokit-ui/r/chat-message.json
```

## Import path canonical form

```ts
// All components ship via the single barrel.
import { Button, Table, ConfirmDialog, CopyButton } from "@theokit/ui";

// Themes + provider:
import { ThemeProvider, violetForge, classicPaper, auroraTerminal } from "@theokit/ui";

// Pure utility (no React):
import { cn } from "@theokit/ui";

// Engines ship under subpaths (separate bundles, opt-in peer-deps):
import { Whiteboard } from "@theokit/ui/whiteboard";
import { Slide } from "@theokit/ui/slide";
import { SlideDeck } from "@theokit/ui/slide-deck";
import { Mermaid } from "@theokit/ui/slide/plugins/mermaid";
import { Math } from "@theokit/ui/slide/plugins/math";
import { Shiki } from "@theokit/ui/slide/plugins/shiki";
import { Emoji } from "@theokit/ui/slide/plugins/emoji";
import { theoUIVitePlugin } from "@theokit/ui/vite-plugin";
import "@theokit/ui/preset";       // Tailwind v4 preset (zero-config)
```

There are **105 subpath exports** in `package.json#exports` — one per component plus engine entry points. **As of 0.10.0-next.0** (Brief #4), per-component subpath imports (`@theokit/ui/button`) point at real per-component dist files (`dist/primitives/button/index.js`) instead of the barrel — switching to subpath form measurably shrinks the consumer's `@theokit/ui` chunk by dropping unused components. Before 0.10, subpath imports were cosmetic (all aliased the barrel). The barrel form keeps working, additive migration shape (same as `@mui/material`).

## Peer dependencies (required vs optional)

**Required for the main barrel:**
- `react >=18.2.0 <20`
- `react-dom >=18.2.0 <20`
- `tailwindcss ^4.0.0`

**Optional (only required if you use the matching engine subpath):**
- `@tailwindcss/vite ^4.0.0`, `vite ^6 || ^7` — for `@theokit/ui/vite-plugin`
- `roughjs ^4.6`, `perfect-freehand ^1.2` — for `@theokit/ui/whiteboard`
- `mdast-util-from-markdown`, `mdast-util-gfm`, `mdast-util-to-hast`, `hast-util-sanitize`, `hast-util-to-jsx-runtime`, `micromark-extension-gfm`, `unist-util-visit`, `unist-util-visit-parents`, `yaml` — for `@theokit/ui/slide`
- `shiki ^1.0` — for `@theokit/ui/slide/plugins/shiki`
- `katex ^0.16`, `mdast-util-math`, `micromark-extension-math` — for `@theokit/ui/slide/plugins/math`
- `mermaid ^11.0` — for `@theokit/ui/slide/plugins/mermaid`
- `hast-util-from-html` — for `@theokit/ui/slide/plugins/emoji`

**Already bundled (do NOT install separately):** `@radix-ui/*`, `class-variance-authority`, `clsx`, `cmdk`, `lucide-react`, `tailwind-merge`. These are `dependencies`, not peer.

## Taxonomy (mechanical rule, gate-enforced)

- **Primitive** = a component that imports **zero** other `@theokit/ui` components. Lives in `src/components/primitives/`.
- **Composite** = a component that imports **one or more** primitives via their barrel `index.js`. Lives in `src/components/composites/`.
- The gate `scripts/validate-quality-gates.ts` is **hard-fail** if either rule is violated. A primitive that grows to need a sibling primitive must be **promoted to composite** by moving the folder + renaming via PR with rationale.
- Composites import siblings via barrel: `import { Button } from "../../primitives/button/index.js"` — NOT via the raw `.tsx` file (also gate-enforced).
- Sub-component pattern (e.g., `Table.Header`, `Sidebar.Item`, `DangerZone.Action`) is implemented via `Object.assign(Root, { SubA, SubB })` — Sidebar-style. Single import surface, attached as static properties on the root.

## Theme system

- **Provider:** `themes` is REQUIRED — the provider does not import the catalog for you.

  ```tsx
  import { ThemeProvider, builtinThemes } from "@theokit/ui";

  <ThemeProvider themes={builtinThemes} defaultTheme="violet-forge" defaultMode="dark">
    {children}
  </ThemeProvider>
  ```

  Props: `themes` (required), `defaultTheme`, `defaultMode` (`"light" | "dark"`, defaults to
  `"dark"` — the library is dark-first), `storageKey`, `defaultDensity`, `respectSystemMode`.
- **Built-in themes (11):** `violetForge` (default), `falconRed`, `classicPaper`, `auroraTerminal`,
  `vercelMono`, `githubDark`, `dracula`, `oneDark`, `anthropicStyle`, `openaiStyle`, `linearGlass`.
  All eleven are re-exported as the `builtinThemes` array.
- **Custom themes:** `defineTheme({ name, label?, description?, light?, dark?, fonts?, fontUrls? })`.
  `light` and `dark` are `Partial<ColorScale>` — anything omitted falls back to Violet Forge, so a
  theme can be four lines. The returned `Theme` goes into the `themes` array:

  ```ts
  export const mine = defineTheme({
    name: "mine",
    dark: { background: "#131314", card: "#1e1f20", success: "#81c995" },
    fonts: { body: "Roboto, sans-serif", mono: "Roboto Mono, monospace" },
  });
  ```

  `ColorScale` covers surfaces, semantics (`success` / `warning` / `destructive` / `info`) and the
  `status-*` family. Components read these tokens — change `success` and every status pill,
  capability indicator and session dot follows.
- **Overriding a single token in your own CSS:** supported — the palette ships inside
  `@layer theme`, so unlayered consumer CSS and `@layer base` both win. It did NOT work before the
  fix for usetheokit/theokit-ui#72: the tokens were unlayered and silently outranked everything a
  consumer wrote. Prefer `defineTheme` for a whole palette; reach for a CSS override when you need
  one value in one place.
- **Color helpers:** `hex("#7c5cff")`, `rgb(124, 92, 255)` — both return CSS-ready strings.
- **Density:** `useDensity()` hook returns `"compact" | "comfortable" | "cozy"`. Cascading via `<DensityProvider>`.
- **Fonts (locked):** Geist Sans (display + body) + Geist Mono (mono). Loaded via CDN by default (`dist/fonts-cdn.css`) or locally (`dist/fonts.css`).
- **Tailwind v4:** CSS-first config via `@theokit/ui/preset` (zero JS config). v3 legacy preset available at `@theokit/ui/preset-v3-legacy`.

## Component catalog

Primitives live in `src/components/primitives/{slug}/`, composites in
`src/components/composites/{slug}/`. Each ships `.tsx` + `.test.tsx` +
`.stories.tsx` + `index.ts`, and every registry-published component also has a
`registry/r/{slug}.json` descriptor.

The component list is **not duplicated here** — it drifts the moment a component
lands. Read it from the generated census instead, which `pnpm sync:readme`
rewrites from the filesystem on every change:

- `/README.md` — catalog section, grouped by primitive/composite
- `/wiki/registry/component-census.md` — the same census with per-component detail
- `/package.json#exports` — the authoritative subpath list
- `/src/index.ts` — the barrel; every public component appears here
- `/registry/index.json` — the 100 registry-published items

Current census: **103 components (63 primitives + 40 composites)**, 100 registry
items, 7 screens.

## Recent deliveries (PaaS shape)

- **0.12.0-next.0 (design guide + companion agent skill, 2026-05-25):** Two LLM-facing artifacts that complemented `llms.txt` — a root-level 9-section visual spec and a companion agent skill installable via the vercel-labs/skills CLI. **Both were retired since.** The normative design-system knowledge they carried (visual theme, color palette, typography, layout, elevation, responsive rules, do's and don'ts) now lives in `wiki/design-system/` — `color-tokens.md`, `themes.md`, `spacing-radii-elevation.md`, `density.md`, `motion.md`, `accessibility.md`, `anti-glass.md` — which is the single source of truth. Neither artifact ships in the npm tarball.
- **0.11.0-next.0 (Brief #5 — 3 dashboard primitives + 2 pre-reqs, 2026-05-25):** Closes 3 measured TheoCloud Deep Review findings. `PinInput` (6-box OTP input with auto-advance, paste handling, mask, error — closes § 2.12 P2). `DataTable` composite (sortable + sticky + expandable rows with `expandMode="single"|"multiple"` + row actions via DropdownMenu + client-side pagination + loading skeleton + empty state — closes Top-5 #2 / § 2.2 + § 2.4 P1). `PageShell` composite (page-level scaffold with state precedence loading > error > empty > children; does NOT manage document.title — exposes `onTitleChange` callback for consumer-scope hook — closes CC-3 indirect; D3 scope decision). Plus 2 explicit pre-requisites the brief assumed existed: `DropdownMenu` primitive (Radix wrapper consolidating 5 prior direct usages) and `ActionBar` primitive (search + filter + primary action; composed by PageShell). Zero new peer-deps. ADR `page-shell-composite-pattern.md` documents the scope-narrowing decision.
- **0.10.0-next.0 (Brief #4 — subpath tree-shaking, build pipeline fix):** ~100 cosmetic subpath exports (every entry pointed at the same 417 KB barrel) replaced with real per-component dist files via tsup auto-glob + `splitting: true`. `dist/index.js` shrank from 417 KB → 49 KB (−88%) because all component code now lives in 119 shared chunks. Per-component dist files (~150-200 bytes each) are tiny re-export wrappers. Per-component `.d.ts` not emitted (would OOM tsup worker pool) — types resolve via barrel `dist/index.d.ts`. `scripts/regen-subpath-exports.ts` runs after every build to keep `package.json#exports` honest (refuses to write if any straggler points at the barrel). Zero breaking change; consumer migration is opt-in file-by-file. ADR at `wiki/decisions/subpath-exports-per-component.md`.
- **0.9.0-next.0 (Brief #3 — deferred follow-ups, 2 components):** `Alert` (persistent inline notice; 4 intents — info/success/warning/destructive — with mapped lucide icons and role=alert for destructive vs role=status for others; optional title/description/action/onDismiss), `Pagination` (accessible nav landmark with first/prev/numbers/next/last + visual ellipses + aria-current=page; keyboard nav ArrowLeft/Right/Home/End; configurable siblingCount + jump buttons + size; returns null when totalPages <= 1; exports a pure `computePageRange` helper for unit-testing the range logic in isolation). Zero new peer-deps. Brief #3 consumer: TheoCloud `<VerificationBanner>` → 3-line `<Alert>`.
- **0.8.0-next.0 (Brief #2 — cross-cutting, 8 components):** `Table` (sub-components + sortable headers), `StatusDot` (5 kinds + auto-pulse), `CopyButton` (clipboard + `aria-live` + SSR-safe), `Timestamp` (`Intl.RelativeTimeFormat`, native `title` tooltip, Unix ms only), `StatTile` (dual button/div mode), `DangerZone` (`.Action` sub-component), `ConfirmDialog` (typed-phrase guard + async loading + Enter-to-confirm), `CodeBlock` (terminal prefix + caption + raw-code copy). Consumer: TheoCloud dashboard. Zero new peer-deps; bundle +5.4% (rebaselined).
- **0.7.0-next.0 (Brief #1 — PaaS-shape, 4 components):** `UsageMeter` (multi-metric, over-quota warning + clamping), `Progress` (4 intents + indeterminate + motion-reduce aware), `PlanBadge` (5 canonical tiers), `AccountMenu` (avatar + name + plan + secondary, dual button/div).

## Component conventions (do this)

Every component file MUST:

1. Use `forwardRef<HTMLElementType, Props>` and set `displayName`. Example: `MyComponent.displayName = "MyComponent";`.
2. Compose classes via `cn(...)` from `lib/cn.js` (`tailwind-merge` + `clsx` underneath).
3. Use **design tokens** only — never raw hex/rgb. Approved tokens: `bg-card`, `bg-muted`, `bg-muted/40`, `bg-primary`, `bg-primary/10`, `bg-success`, `bg-warning`, `bg-destructive`, `bg-destructive/[0.02]`, `text-foreground`, `text-muted-foreground`, `text-success`, `text-warning`, `text-destructive`, `border-border/40`, `border-border/60`, `border-destructive/30`, `text-card-foreground`, `text-primary-foreground`, `ring-ring`, etc.
4. Use **typography scale**: `text-display-md`, `text-title-sm`, `text-body-sm`, `text-label`, `text-label-caps`, `font-display`, `font-sans`, `font-mono` — never raw `text-xl`/`text-base`/`text-sm`.
5. Use `lucide-react` for icons. Never inline SVG. Icons rendered as components (`<Copy aria-hidden="true" className="size-3.5" />`).
6. Use CVA (`class-variance-authority`) for variant APIs that have ≥3 options (Button, Badge, Progress intent, etc.).
7. Pass `aria-label` for icon-only triggers. Use `<span className="sr-only" aria-live="polite">` for state announcements (CopyButton pattern).
8. Tests use `vitest` + `@testing-library/react` + `vitest-axe`. Every interactive primitive ships `expect(await axe(container)).toHaveNoViolations()`. Async assertions use `findBy*` with `{ timeout: 5000 }` headroom for parallel vitest pool.
9. Stories ship in Ladle (`.stories.tsx`). Title pattern: `"Primitives / {Category} / {Name}"` or `"Composites / {Category} / {Name}"`.
10. Registry descriptor in `registry/{slug}.json` with shadcn schema. Each entry declares `dependencies` (npm) + `registryDependencies` (other registry items in this project).

## Anti-patterns (do NOT)

- **Do NOT** add raw hex/rgb. Always use tokens. The design-audit gate fails the build if it finds them.
- **Do NOT** install Radix / CVA / lucide-react separately — they're bundled `dependencies`.
- **Do NOT** import a sibling primitive into another primitive (taxonomy gate hard-fails). Either inline the dep or promote to composite.
- **Do NOT** import via `../../primitives/foo/foo.js` from a composite — use `../../primitives/foo/index.js` (gate hard-fails).
- **Do NOT** wrap dropdown/dialog/select in your own Portal. Radix manages portals correctly.
- **Do NOT** disable a quality gate or add `eslint-disable`/`biome-ignore` to silence one — fix the root cause. Acceptable biome-ignore comments must include a `WAI-ARIA …` or equivalent justification.
- **Do NOT** roll your own clipboard, focus-trap, accessible dialog, color parser, markdown renderer, syntax highlighter, or relative-time formatter — use `<CopyButton>`, Radix Dialog, `Intl.RelativeTimeFormat`, etc.
- **Do NOT** ship CJS (`require()`). ESM only. The TypeScript output is `.js` with `.d.ts` siblings.
- **Do NOT** rename the locked names (see below) without a strategic review.
- **Do NOT** use emojis in code, README, JSDoc, or CHANGELOG. (User-facing copy in docs is OK if explicitly requested.)
- **Do NOT** invent integration that doesn't exist. As of 2026-05-23, `@theokit/ui` has **no** import from `@theokit/sdk`, `theokit`, or `theo-code`. Verify with `grep` before claiming wiring.

## Locked names (immutable without strategic review)

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| npm package | `@theokit/ui` |
| Codename | Violet Forge |
| Default theme | `violet-forge` |
| Built-in themes (3 originals) | `violet-forge`, `classic-paper`, `aurora-terminal` |
| ThemeProvider component | `<ThemeProvider />` |
| Registry endpoint (planned canonical) | `ui.usetheo.dev/r/*.json` |
| Module format | ESM only |
| Quality-gate command | `pnpm quality:gates` |
| Test framework | Vitest |
| Stories framework | Ladle |
| Linter / formatter | Biome (`biome check`, `biome format`) |
| Component taxonomy | `primitive` (no internal deps) vs `composite` (≥1 internal dep) |
| Fonts | Geist Sans + Geist Mono (CDN by default) |

## Engines (subpath-isolated, opt-in)

These ship under their own subpath because they require heavy peer-deps. **Do NOT** include in the main barrel.

| Engine | Subpath | Required peer-deps |
|---|---|---|
| Whiteboard (Excalidraw-style view) | `@theokit/ui/whiteboard` | `roughjs`, `perfect-freehand` |
| Slide (Marp-style view) | `@theokit/ui/slide` | `mdast-util-*`, `hast-util-*`, `micromark-extension-gfm`, `unist-util-visit*`, `yaml` |
| SlideDeck | `@theokit/ui/slide-deck` | inherits from Slide |
| Slide plugin — Shiki | `@theokit/ui/slide/plugins/shiki` | `shiki` |
| Slide plugin — Math (KaTeX) | `@theokit/ui/slide/plugins/math` | `katex`, `mdast-util-math`, `micromark-extension-math` |
| Slide plugin — Mermaid | `@theokit/ui/slide/plugins/mermaid` | `mermaid` |
| Slide plugin — Emoji | `@theokit/ui/slide/plugins/emoji` | `hast-util-from-html` |
| Vite plugin | `@theokit/ui/vite-plugin` | `vite ^6 || ^7`, `@tailwindcss/vite` |

All engines documented under RFC 0001 / 0002 / 0003 / 0004 in `wiki/rfcs/`. View-only (no editing) by design.

## Quality gates (run via `pnpm quality:gates`)

The full chain runs in CI and must be 100% green for any PR to merge:

1. `format:check` — Biome formatter
2. `lint:ci` — Biome linter (strict)
3. `typecheck` — `tsc --noEmit` (strict TS)
4. `test` — Vitest run (1532+ tests including `vitest-axe` a11y)
5. `build` — tsup (ESM + d.ts + CSS)
6. `registry:build` + `registry:validate` — shadcn descriptors
7. `quality:structure` — taxonomy + readme drift + design-audit + test/story coverage
8. `quality:bundle` — `dist/index.js` size delta within ±5% baseline (rebaseline explicit via `--update`)
9. `quality:a11y` — every interactive Ladle story axe-validated (~226 tests)
10. `ladle:build` — verify Ladle compiles
11. `dogfood:*` — end-to-end smoke against each engine

## Test conventions

- Framework: **Vitest** (NOT Jest). Use `vi.fn()`, `vi.spyOn()`, `vi.useFakeTimers()`.
- Renderer: `@testing-library/react`. Always `render(<C ... />)`, never manual `ReactDOM.render`.
- A11y: `import { axe } from "vitest-axe"; expect(await axe(container)).toHaveNoViolations();`
- Async assertions: `await screen.findByText(...)` (not `getByText` then `waitFor`). For tests under parallel vitest pool stress, add `{ timeout: 5000 }`.
- Radix dialog tests: use `baseElement` (not `container`) for portal-rendered content. Disable `aria-hidden-focus` rule on axe runs over Dialog content — it's a false positive on Radix's focus-guard spans.
- Clipboard tests: `vi.stubGlobal("navigator", { clipboard: { writeText: vi.fn() } });`.
- Time/Date tests: `vi.useFakeTimers(); vi.setSystemTime(new Date("2026-05-23T12:00:00Z"));`.

## Stories convention (Ladle)

```tsx
import type { Story } from "@ladle/react";
import { MyComponent } from "./my-component.js";

export default { title: "Primitives / Category / MyComponent" };

export const Default: Story = () => <MyComponent prop="value" />;
```

Run dev server: `pnpm dev` (Ladle on `http://localhost:61000`). Build static: `pnpm ladle:build`. Title pattern is enforced for sidebar grouping.

## Source-of-truth files (read these before claiming anything)

1. `/CONTRIBUTING.md` — operational handbook (taxonomy gate, quality gates, PR flow, inviolable rules)
2. `/README.md` — public catalog + quality gates + dev scripts (auto-synced from filesystem by `pnpm sync:readme`)
3. `/CHANGELOG.md` — every release entry, including [Unreleased] section
4. `/package.json#exports` — the authoritative list of subpath imports (auto-synced by `pnpm sync:exports`)
5. `/src/index.ts` — the barrel; every public component appears here
6. `/wiki/architecture/index.md` — folder layout + module boundaries
7. `/wiki/design-system/index.md` — tokens, fonts, type scale (Geist + Vercel scale, locked)
8. `/wiki/rfcs/*.md` — engine RFCs (whiteboard 0001, slide 0002, slide-deck 0003, slide-rich-content 0004, themes 0007, integration 0008, chat-message 0009)
9. `/scripts/validate-quality-gates.ts` — the taxonomy + structure gate
10. `/wiki/index.md` — the OKF knowledge bundle root: architecture, design system, quality gates, decisions, RFCs, engines, migrations, registry and history

## How to add a new component (the rote checklist)

1. Decide taxonomy: does it import another `@theokit/ui` component? If yes → composite. If no → primitive.
2. Create folder: `src/components/{primitives,composites}/{kebab-name}/`
3. Create 4 files: `{slug}.tsx`, `{slug}.test.tsx`, `{slug}.stories.tsx`, `index.ts`
4. Implement with `forwardRef` + `displayName` + `cn()` + lucide icons + design tokens + typography scale
5. Tests: ≥6 unit tests including 1 `vitest-axe` assertion
6. Stories: ≥3 Ladle stories (variants/sizes/states)
7. Add registry descriptor: `registry/{slug}.json` with `$schema`, `name`, `type: "registry:ui"`, `title`, `description`, `dependencies`, `registryDependencies`, `files`
8. Add export to `src/index.ts` (the barrel)
9. Run `pnpm sync:exports && pnpm sync:readme` to regenerate `package.json#exports` + README + architecture catalog + Ladle stats
10. Add CHANGELOG entry under `## [Unreleased]` → `### Added` with one bullet per component
11. Run `pnpm quality:gates` — must be 100% green
12. If shipping to consumers, also write a curated MDX page in `theo-opendocs` (NEVER use auto-gen `/components/` dir — that's broken legacy)

## Cross-project positioning

`@theokit/ui` is the **UI pillar** of the `usetheo` ecosystem. Other pillars:

- **Harness** — `@theokit/sdk` (Claude Agent SDK consumer). No current import from `@theokit/ui`.
- **Skills** — `theokit` (agent framework). No current import.
- **Runtime** — Theo PaaS (cloud platform, pre-release). No current import; `<DeploymentRow>`, `<BuildLogStream>`, `<RollbackUI>`, `<EnvVarEditor>`, `<DomainConfig>`, `<PreviewEnvCard>`, `<ProjectCard>`, `<MetricsPanel>`, and the new Brief #1 + #2 components are designed for it but currently unused.

`@theokit/ui` is **community auxiliary**: Apache-2.0, usable standalone, no commitment to the rest of the stack. The integration story above is aspirational; verify with `grep` before claiming wiring exists in any consumer.
